note: Pre-registered rules for the intra-index regime study. NEVER edit a rule after its freeze date -- a changed rule is a new rule id with its own freeze date. The nightly regime-state build evaluates these against live data and the scoring workflow appends the readings (and, 21 sessions later, realized outcomes) to the regime-scoring-data branch. The forward log is the only evidence that can upgrade the study's in-sample claims. all_dispersed_derisk_v2 was added 2026-09-22 with its own freeze date (per-rule frozen_utc); the three 2026-08-20 rules are untouched.
zone_basis: rolling 504-session percentiles, 30/40/30 split (cz_roll / dz_roll_l1 in intra_index_regime_study.py); DIX zone always on the one-session-lagged signal (FINRA publishes after the close). The v2 rule reads cz_ewm_roll: the same rolling 30/40/30 split on the exponentially weighted correlation gauge (avg_pairwise_corr_ewm, half-life 10 sessions), which has no window edge.

ndx_tilt_screen_v1.description: Avoid-screen: while the NDX comovement zone is LowCorr, names in the top 20% of the per-name dark-flow tilt (5d-MA raw dark ratio minus own expanding mean, payload panel) are flagged as avoid. Hypothesis at freeze: flagged names lag the rest of the index over the next 21 sessions (point-in-time in-sample estimate -0.6pp/month, episode CI touching zero).
ndx_tilt_screen_v1.emits: list of flagged tickers, refreshed daily, intended for weekly use
ndx_tilt_screen_v1.outcome: mean 21-session forward return of flagged names minus unflagged NDX names, resolved in batch by the study against the then-current payload (--score-log); the nightly scorer records the names only

ndx_dixlow_caution_v1.description: Caution flag: NDX comovement zone LowCorr AND lag-1 DIX zone DIXLow. Hypothesis at freeze: flagged days run ~2pp/month below the same-period baseline (the corrected study's surviving index-level leg; era-adjusted -2.4pp in-sample).
ndx_dixlow_caution_v1.active_when: NDX cz_roll == LowCorr and NDX dz_roll_l1 == DIXLow
ndx_dixlow_caution_v1.outcome: QQQ 21-session forward return on flagged days vs non-flagged LowCorr days, resolved from the scoring log's own closes

all_dispersed_derisk_v1.description: Risk flag: all three indices' comovement zones LowCorr simultaneously. Hypothesis at freeze: flagged days run below the same-period baseline in all three indices (era-adjusted -1.6 to -2.1pp in-sample; episode CIs include zero -- this rule exists to settle exactly that).
all_dispersed_derisk_v1.active_when: NDX, SPX and IWM cz_roll all == LowCorr
all_dispersed_derisk_v1.outcome: QQQ/SPY/IWM 21-session forward returns on flagged vs non-flagged days, resolved from the scoring log's own closes

all_dispersed_derisk_v2.description: Risk flag, window-edge-free variant of v1: all three indices' EW comovement zones (cz_ewm_roll) LowCorr simultaneously. Why a v2: the rectangular 21-session gauge forgets a shock day in one step, so all three indices flipped into LowCorr on the same date (2026-04-30, the session the 2026-03-31 shock day left every window) -- v1's three readings are one event at episode entry, not three. On the EW gauge the same episode's entries fall on 2026-04-24 (SPX), 04-27 (IWM) and 04-29 (NDX). Hypothesis at freeze: flagged days run below the same-period baseline in all three indices (in-sample, rolling basis, 2020-12-30 -> 2026-09-21: 497 days / 44 episodes; era-adjusted NDX -1.9pp, SPX -1.3pp, IWM -0.8pp; every episode CI includes zero -- the same open question as v1, on a gauge whose episode boundaries the tape sets).
all_dispersed_derisk_v2.active_when: NDX, SPX and IWM cz_ewm_roll all == LowCorr
all_dispersed_derisk_v2.outcome: QQQ/SPY/IWM 21-session forward returns on flagged vs non-flagged days, resolved from the scoring log's own closes (ruleD_active in state.csv)
